## Claude Code

1. **Run the command** — Run the command below in your terminal.
2. **Sign in to Backlane** — Open /mcp in Claude Code, select backlane and complete sign-in in your browser.
3. **Check the connection** — Ask which marketplaces are connected.

**Terminal**

```sh
claude mcp add --transport http backlane 'https://app.getbacklane.com/mcp'
```

### Alternative: plugin with the Backlane skill

```text
/plugin marketplace add pschlieker/getbacklane
/plugin install backlane@backlane
```

[Official instructions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)

## Check the connection

> Which marketplaces have I connected to Backlane?

Ask your AI assistant to call Backlane's list_integrations tool. A successful tool call confirms the MCP connection. An empty connection list means a marketplace still needs connecting; it is not an MCP connection failure.
